title: Upper ME: Press
warmup: Foam roll 2 min, then 2 rounds: Lateral Lunge × 6/side · Eccentric Push-Up with Extension × 5 · Bird Dog × 6/side
jumps: DB Bench Press 3 · 3-sec pause @ RPE 8.5 → Plyometric Push-Up 5 → Med Ball Chest Pass 5 → Medicine Ball Slams 5
Isometric wk 2: heavier, same dead-stop pause · 10–20 sec between steps, 3:00 between rounds
note: Isometric wk 2: more weight, same 3-second dead stop. Own the bottom.
